name: TeamStarWolf - Active Directory
description: Curated practitioner view of Active Directory intrusion behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping. Sources: ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_ATTACK_REFERENCE.md, ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_ATTACKS.md, and data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl. Selects explicitly referenced techniques for enumeration, credential access, Kerberos and NTLM abuse, certificate abuse, remote execution, and persistence. Tactics are taken from the technique profiles, not inferred from document section labels. Scores indicate membership only.

techniques.comment: Credential dumping exposes authentication material used in domain environments. Sources: ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_ATTACKS.md.
LSASS memory can expose account credentials. Sources: ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_ATTACKS.md.
The SAM database can expose local account password material on domain-joined hosts. Sources: ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_ATTACKS.md.
The NTDS database holds Active Directory credential material. Sources: ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_ATTACKS.md.
DCSync abuses directory replication access to retrieve credential material. Sources: ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_ATTACK_REFERENCE.md, ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_ATTACKS.md.
SMB and administrative shares support remote access between Windows hosts. Sources: ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_ATTACKS.md.
